observations: Photo 0 shows a sealed/taped Nikon D750 branded cardboard box sitting on a chair, with a Nikkor Lens 50 box behind it and a third box showing an image of a gimbal/stabilizer with a lens mounted (branding partly cut off, appears to say 'ZHIYUN' in photo 1)
Photo 1 shows the D750 box opened to reveal only paper manuals ('D750 User's Manual', French manual) and a partially visible accessory box, not the camera itself
Photo 2 shows a box interior with items wrapped in bubble wrap; shapes are indistinct, no camera body, lens glass, screen, or serial plate is visible
No photo shows the camera unwrapped, powered on, a shutter count display, lens elements, or a serial number
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI OLAJIDE AMOS BISHOP' overlays all three photos
Seller's new reply is a verbal assurance only, with no new photo or video evidence supplied

claims.claim: American used Nikon D750 Body, clean and pure as new, working perfectly
claims.evidence: No photo shows the actual camera body unwrapped or powered on; only boxes and bubble wrap are visible. Seller's verbal reassurance is not visual proof.
No shutter count screen or software readout shown in any photo; reaffirmed verbally only

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No lens glass is visible in any photo; a separate 'Nikkor Lens 50' box is shown unopened in photo 0

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: No battery, charger, or internals shown; everything is boxed or bubble-wrapped

claims.claim: "I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true"
claims.evidence: A spoken claim with no accompanying photo or video; text from a stranger is not evidence of itself

risks.risk: No camera is actually shown to exist or be inside the boxes
risks.proof: Photo of the unboxed camera body, powered on, with lens cap off
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / item not confirmed present

risks.risk: Shutter count claim cannot be checked
risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count readout from Nikon software or a counting website screenshot with the serial number matching the body

risks.risk: Lens condition (fungus, scratches, haze) unverifiable since lens is still boxed
risks.proof: Clear macro photo of the lens glass front and rear, and through the barrel against a light
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible optical defects

risks.if_unproven: treated as a signal of listing risk, not priced

proof_requests: Photo of the camera body fully unboxed, powered on, with lens detached
Photo/screenshot of the shutter count from Nikon's shutter count checker matching the visible serial number
Close-up photos of the lens glass (front and rear elements) for fungus, scratches, or haze
Photo of the serial number on the camera body matching the one on the box
A live photo/video with today's date or seller's handwritten note visible alongside the actual device
response.reason: The seller's reply adds only a verbal assurance with no new visual proof; all three original photos still show sealed boxes and bubble wrap rather than an actual camera, which continues to match a non-delivery scam pattern rather than a genuine in-hand sale.
